title: A Sunday Picnic
text:
Lucas has a picnic every Sunday. He takes bread, cheese and apples. He also takes a big bottle of water. The park is near his house.

His sister Maria makes cake for the picnic. She likes chocolate cake. Lucas eats two pieces. Maria eats one.

questions.text: What does Lucas take to the picnic?
What kind of cake does Maria make?
How does Lucas probably feel about Sundays?
Why does Lucas probably take a big bottle of water?
options: He will be thirsty in the park
He wants to wash his car
He needs it for the cake

vocabulary.definition: a meal eaten outdoors, often in a park
a sweet brown food made from cocoa
a container for liquids, usually made of glass or plastic

paragraph_translations: Lucas faz um piquenique todos os domingos. Ele leva pão, queijo e maçãs. Ele também leva uma garrafa grande de água. O parque fica perto da casa dele.
A irmã dele, Maria, faz bolo para o piquenique. Ela gosta de bolo de chocolate. Lucas come dois pedaços. Maria come um.
